description: The nth Genocchi number |G(2n)|, from G(2n) = 2*(1-4^n)*B(2n) with B(1) = +1/2. The first four absolute values are 1, 1, 3, and 17. signed is (-1)^n times that value. n runs from 1 to 20. Past 15 digits a value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: n, value, signed.
